Requests:
[t0] I would like to submit a request to delete this account and its personal data. Please review the account data that is eligible for deletion or de-identification. A short confirmation when the process is complete is sufficient.
[t1] I would like to submit a request to delete this account and its personal data. Please review the account data that is eligible for deletion or de-identification. I would appreciate confirmation of the final outcome.
[t2] I would like to submit a request to delete this account and its personal data. Please review the account data that is eligible for deletion or de-identification. Please confirm when the review is complete.
[t3] I would like to submit a request to delete this account and its personal data. Please review the account data that is eligible for deletion or de-identification. Please contact me if you need information to verify the request.
[t4] I'd like to download my account information in a portable format. Please keep the account as it is.
[t5] Intenté eliminar mi cuenta ayer, pero la página terminó mostrando un error. ¿Pueden comprobar si todavía queda algún dato y completar la eliminación si hace falta?
[t6] I’m deleting my account. You can keep anonymous statistics, but nothing in analytics should still point back to me.
[t7] Je demande la suppression définitive du compte associé à cette adresse e-mail. Veuillez examiner les identifiants actuels et antérieurs conformément à votre procédure de confidentialité. Merci de confirmer le résultat une fois la vérification terminée.
[t8] My account page is gone, but my old profile still appears when I search for it. Can you remove that search result too?
[t9] My surname is misspelled on the account. Can you correct it without removing any of my records?
[t10] Please audit the deletion as it stood when my request was reviewed. I want confirmation that the account was fully removed at that point.
[t11] Please begin the deletion process for the account using this email address. Please apply the correct treatment to records covered by the request. Let me know when the request has been completed.
[t12] Please begin the deletion process for the account using this email address. Please apply the request across the systems covered by your deletion policy. A short confirmation when the process is complete is sufficient.
[t13] Please begin the deletion process for the account using this email address. Please check the records connected to the account before confirming completion. Please confirm the result after completing the required checks.
[t14] Please begin the deletion process for the account using this email address. Please check the records connected to the account before confirming completion. Please confirm when the review is complete.
[t15] Please begin the deletion process for the account using this email address. Please check the records connected to the account before confirming completion. Please contact me if you need information to verify the request.
[t16] Please begin the deletion process for the account using this email address. Please check the records connected to the account before confirming completion. Please let me know once the request has been reviewed.
[t17] Please begin the deletion process for the account using this email address. Please complete the normal identity and data review for this request. Please let me know once the request has been reviewed.
[t18] Please begin the deletion process for the account using this email address. Please ensure the request is applied to the relevant account records. A short confirmation when the process is complete is sufficient.
[t19] Please begin the deletion process for the account using this email address. Please ensure the request is applied to the relevant account records. Please let me know once the request has been reviewed.
[t20] Please begin the deletion process for the account using this email address. Please follow the applicable retention and deletion requirements for the account. A short confirmation when the process is complete is sufficient.
[t21] Please begin the deletion process for the account using this email address. Please follow the applicable retention and deletion requirements for the account. Please let me know once the request has been reviewed.
[t22] Please begin the deletion process for the account using this email address. Please handle any copies that fall within the scope of the deletion request. I would appreciate confirmation of the final outcome.
[t23] Please begin the deletion process for the account using this email address. Please handle any copies that fall within the scope of the deletion request. Let me know when the request has been completed.
[t24] Please begin the deletion process for the account using this email address. Please handle any copies that fall within the scope of the deletion request. Please confirm the result after completing the required checks.
